ICS 13.310                         MED 24Revised Standard from Last Update.1 SCOPEThis standard lays down the requirements regarding construction of book room doors which afford a degree of protection against burglarious attacks and fire.2 REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards given in Annex A.
